description: (1) QE: the typed-decode failure branch of read_state has zero coverage — add unknown-field and wrong-type fixtures. comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FIXES LANDED (commit daacdc84): typed-decode fixtures (unknown-field, wrong-type) exercise the last uncovered read branch; the cross-platform directory-as-path companion covers the IO kind everywhere and the two mode-bit tests skip DELIBERATELY under euid 0 with a printed reason; the snapshot test asserts the exact four; dispatch-data gains value pins (five members, fifteen fields, three result values) and state-schema's pin is the #725 mirror test; corruption tests assert the tamper took and filter to files; degraded_kinds and wiring_outcomes typed with the deepening-layer annotations on the remaining Value fields. RESIDUE, declared: property tests for the three pure targets stay Phase 5 territory per the verification architecture — recorded as the deliberate gap the QE coverage note named. Validator: data-engineer.
